When an employee leaves Orbit Labs, the manager must complete the following steps in order:

1. Revoke VPN and single sign-on access on the last working day.
2. Collect the laptop, access card and any issued peripherals.
3. Transfer ownership of shared documents to the manager.
4. Conduct an exit interview within 5 working days of the resignation date.
5. Confirm final settlement with Finance within 30 days.
